scope: Teufelsboy/HSConfig on branch codex/hsconfig-contract-spine-guard-wave at HEAD 7877fdf22b8de421ac9926440e5f5f081882b5cc, auditing the current source-claim to runtime contract spine across supported atomic claim kinds, source_contract_matrix policy rows, source_claim_lifecycle, source_claim_conflicts, --plan-reports-dir override filtering, surface gates, builder/router lowering, source_contract_audit, source_to_runtime_explainability, contract_spine_sentinel, output_ownership_manifest, and reports/operator_summary.json as the only normal apply authority.
verified_strengths: The repository currently supports 15 atomic claim kinds: archetype, mulligan_keep, mulligan_discard, card_role, targeting_rule, combo_sequence, gameplan_posture, hero_power_transform, mechanic_usage, known_bad_pattern, tech_slot, replacement_option, discover_choice, choose_one_choice, and globalvalue_numeric_tuning.

The source_contract_matrix is complete against SUPPORTED_ATOMIC_CLAIM_KINDS with no missing or extra policy rows, and its live conformance summary reports 5 runtime_lowerable lanes, 6 suppressed_or_conditional lanes, 3 report_only lanes, and 1 runtime_evidence_required lane.

Surface gating is explicit and narrow: only mulligan_keep and mulligan_discard can lower to Mulligan.json, only gameplan_posture can lower to GlobalValues.json in Step 1, only combo_sequence can lower to Combo.json, and only card behavior claim kinds can lower to per-card CardID JSON.

The lifecycle chain is canonicalized in one place: source claim -> normalized claim_kind -> semantic qualifiers -> conflict quarantine -> runtime eligibility -> surface gate -> builder/router decision -> emitted runtime surface or suppression reason.

Conflict handling is explicit and non-destructive: mulligan, targeting, combo_timing, option_choice, and role_vs_known_bad_pattern conflicts are quarantined into report-visible conflicts, and quarantined claims are suppressed from runtime emission instead of creating a second gate.

The --plan-reports-dir override path is lifecycle-filtered before package emission. Override claims are re-normalized, conflict reports are rebuilt, initial lifecycle rows are recomputed, and stale plan rows without allowed claim IDs are filtered out before Mulligan, CardID, Combo, or GlobalValues runtime output is written.

Builder and router lowering aligns with the policy matrix. The conformance snapshot reports zero policy-gate mismatches and zero builder expectation mismatches. The only pipeline attention row is intentional: combo_sequence remains surface-allowed but still suppresses incomplete sequences with sequence_too_short until the builder has a complete sequence.

source_contract_audit.json and source_to_runtime_explainability.json are diagnostic-only by construction. They expose policy lanes, surface gate decisions, builder_or_router_decision, emitted runtime files, suppression reasons, first missing links, and next source actions without contributing apply authority.

contract_spine_sentinel is clean at this HEAD. It confirms no missing claim kinds, no extra claim kinds, no non-diagnostic policy rows, no lifecycle report promoted to a gate, no active apply-path consumers of diagnostic contract artifacts, no forbidden legacy surface routing, and no output ownership drift.

output_ownership_manifest classifies runtime surfaces separately from diagnostics and keeps exactly one gate file. operator_summary.json is the only file classified as gate, while source_contract_audit.json, source_to_runtime_explainability.json, and output_ownership_manifest.json stay diagnostic.

operator_summary aggregates diagnostic summaries as non-blocking visibility only. Runtime apply authority remains reports/operator_summary.json via runtime_apply_contract.apply_authority, and apply_gate.py reads operator_summary.json rather than source_contract_audit, source_to_runtime_explainability, or contract_spine_rows.
guardrails_to_keep: Keep the start-of-game mulligan boundary: start-of-game effect claims such as hero_power_transform must stay effect-visible but must not become opening-hand keeps unless the source explicitly states opening-hand mulligan intent.
Keep globalvalue_numeric_tuning in the runtime_evidence_required lane with no Step 1 runtime surface, so numeric GlobalValues changes cannot bypass runtime evidence.
Keep conflict quarantine inside source_claim_lifecycle and source_claim_conflicts, so contradictory source claims remain visible in reports but cannot leak into runtime rows.

Keep --plan-reports-dir lifecycle filtering, including claim ID based row filtering and wildcard discard preservation only when a concrete mulligan hold still exists, so stale override rows cannot survive as orphan runtime output.

Keep the current subtractive ownership model: report_ownership and output_ownership_manifest must continue to classify only reports/operator_summary.json as gate and must leave lifecycle and explainability reports diagnostic-only.

Keep contract_spine_sentinel and source_contract_conformance as developer diagnostics that detect claim-kind drift, accidental apply fields, lifecycle gate promotion, active apply-path diagnostic coupling, and forbidden legacy surfaces.

Keep apply_gate.py, runtime_apply.py, and commands/apply.py free from imports or token-level dependencies on source_contract_audit, source_to_runtime_explainability, source_contract_conformance, claim_lifecycle_rows, or contract_spine_rows.
Keep the source-informed apply flag behavior as a legacy no-op in active apply paths so no hidden alternate apply branch reappears.
Keep builder prerequisites explicit, especially combo_sequence requiring a complete sequence and CardID lowering requiring documented surface support or exact option identity where applicable.
recommended_next_design: Keep the current subtractive contract spine. New claim kinds should only be introduced by updating SUPPORTED_ATOMIC_CLAIM_KINDS, source_contract_matrix, the matching surface gate, and the matching builder or router tests together. Preserve source_contract_audit, source_to_runtime_explainability, contract_spine_sentinel, source_contract_conformance, and output_ownership_manifest as diagnostic-only visibility layers, and keep reports/operator_summary.json as the only normal apply authority.
